content: To asses the performance of these models on a totally unseen data, we tried to classify the CrowdFlower emotional tweets dataset. The CrowdFlower dataset consists of 40k tweets annotated via crowd-sourcing each with a single emotional label. This dataset is considered a hard dataset to classify with a lot of noise.
